title: Noor and the Signal
author: Yara Vasquez
blurb: Lena Quintana, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
